process.stack_status: present in archived installed-option directory; not evidence of a booked wafer option
process.historical_digital_voltage_status: confirmed by DC report, typical corner

mim.nominal_conditions: 25 C, zero applied terminal voltage, zero process and mismatch offsets
mim.alternative_option_status: model available in archive; use as sensitivity only, selection not verified
mim.dimension_status: stated model extraction structures; these are not proved DRC minimum/maximum dimensions
mim.small_unit_status: outside listed extraction structures; requires a validated small-capacitor implementation and parasitic extraction
mim.baseband_fringe_coefficient_status: no explicit cjsw/fringe coefficient in inspected baseband model; physical fringe and coupling remain unknown
mim.rf_parasitic_status: RF models have separate oxide/substrate branches; these do not prove CDAC ratio parasitics
mim.large_cap_status: single-square equivalent exceeds listed extraction structures; use a validated tiled capacitor bank

io.io_cell_pitch_status: document defines width plus spacing of adjacent IO cells; this is not bonding-pad pitch
io.bonding_pitch_status: depends on separate bond pad placement and packaging; not verified in this task
io.bond_landing_status: PADI35/PADO35 inspected LEF entries contain no PIN; OBS gives full macro-wide blockages, which do not identify landing/opening; actual GDS landing/opening remains unverified
io.radial_depth_status: confirmed common macro height, excludes unverified seal ring / dicing and assembly margins

engineering_assumptions.bond_pitch_status: planning assumptions only, not foundry rules
engineering_assumptions.capacitor_matching_routing_dummy_and_gua: not included in plate-only density formula
engineering_assumptions.analog_cdac_footprint: allocate separately; do not scale the whole CDAC to the tiny ideal plate area

historical_dc.status: mapped-cell area only; report total area includes wire-load interconnect estimate and is not a placed core area
